summary: Both printed pages match the August 2024 PDF structure; removed bogus !important shrink-to-fit overrides in print-overrides/1701ms-2024.css (fixing Part I Col A/B font sizing and Part V Item 9 specify text, and baseline-aligning Items 7 & 9). Remaining two defects (empty Spouse TIN '---00000' and Page 2 full name) live in crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1701ms.rs and are routed as shared changes.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 6 B. Spouse TIN (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1701ms.rs:1480-1481)
defects.what: Empty spouse TIN prints '---00000' instead of staying blank because to_print_field_map unconditionally calls split_tin(&spouse.tin) and emits format!("{a}-{b}-{c}-{branch}") even when spouse.tin is empty.

Static !important font-size rules (7.5px-9.6px) on #p1c29-i/#p1c30-i/#p1c32-i/#p1c33-i/#p1c35-i/#p1c61-i/#p1c64-i/#p1c67-i (with no rule on Spouse #p1c36-i) forced Taxpayer Column A text smaller than Spouse Column B. Removed those overrides so bir-print dynamic sizing handles both columns uniformly. (Item 18 #p1c87-i dynamically shrinks to 6.02pt only because 'BUSINESS INCOME- GRADUATED IT RATES' is 35 chars in a 128.5pt box.)

defects.where: Page 1 Part II Items 25, 27, 29, 30 and Page 2 Part IV.B1 Items 9, 10C, 10D, 12, 13, 14
defects.what: Negative or >8-digit amounts overflow the 8-slot comb boxes and render as left-aligned plain text colliding directly with comb tick marks.

Prints the entire full taxpayer name instead of only the last name because form_1701ms.rs:1473 emits self.taxpayer_name.trim().to_uppercase() without splitting before the first comma (unlike form_1701q.rs:656-663).

Static !important rules (#p2c177-i 4.5px, #p2c179-i 5.5px) forced specify text microscopic and pinned near the top; removed both overrides and baseline-aligned #p2c177-i and #p2c179-i above their underline (Item 9 now prints ~8pt; Item 7 fits dynamically within its 85.5pt single-line slot).

defects.where: Page 2, bottom reference tables (Table 1 ATCs and Table 2 Tax Rates)
defects.what: Reference tables are moved out of the filed sheet into guide.html per provenance.json.

defects.where: Part I, Item 6 Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) - A. Taxpayer/Filer
defects.what: 5-digit branch code ('00000') truncates with an ellipsis ('000...') inside the read-only TIN branch box.

Branch try/forms-neon-1 was rebased onto origin/try/forms-shared-print (058a0e9b) before capturing AFTER.
shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1701ms.rs:1480-1481: guard sp_tin emission with `if !spouse.tin.trim().is_empty()` so empty spouse TIN stays blank instead of printing '---00000'.

crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1701ms.rs:1473: extract last name before the first comma for derived:page2_name (matching form_1701q.rs:656-663) and update the p2c6 test assertion in crates/bir-print/src/frozen_html.rs.
crates/bir-print (owned by neon-4 on try/forms-shared-print): mask comb ticks under overflowing negative/large amounts in Part II and Part IV.B1.
nsh/screens/form/ (shared screen code): widen read-only 5-digit TIN branch code box so '00000' does not truncate to '000...' on 1701MS.
